scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof and reproducible finite checks; possible unknown earlier enumeration under symmetric-square terminology; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for ordinary minimum dominating vertex sets of the labelled two-token graph F_2(K_{3,n}) with integers n>=3. The minimum cardinality n is known; this work refines it to a full structural count with an exceptional family at n=4. No claim for full domination polynomials, higher token numbers or side size >=4.
title: Minimum dominating-set rigidity and a four-column exception in two-token bicliques
